title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 70: Career choices (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Career choices (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Career choices (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the following passage and choose the option that best fits each blank. A 14.1 housing health food career choice is an important decision that can shape your future. Some people decide to attend a vocational 14.2 college orchard kindergarten lighthouse  to learn specific skills for jobs like mechanic, hairdresser, or chef. These schools teach practical skills that help students start working quickly. Others may want to 14.3 create do earn serve  a living in a different way, like working in an office or starting their own business. Whatever you choose, it’s important to think about your interests and strengths. If you want to start a career, you may need to 14.4 care pay apply wait for a job or an internship. This process can help you gain experience and find out if a job is right for you. Remember, it's fine to change your mind as you learn more about different career paths. The most important thing is to choose something that makes you happy and helps you grow.

vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the following dialogues. Dialogue 1: David: What kind of person would be good for a job as a(n) 1.1 ? Linda: It is great for someone who enjoys routine tasks and working with their hands in a fast-paced environment. Dialogue 2: Anna: Do you think I am suitable for working as a(n) 1.2 ? Tom: Definitely! You can make clothes yourself and they are beautiful. It's a perfect job for you! Dialogue 3: Emily: Do you think being a(n) 1.3 is a fun job? Jack: Yes, it’s great for people who enjoy talking to customers and working in a lively place. Dialogue 4: Mia: I’m looking for a part-time job to earn some extra money for my studies. Any suggestions? Mike: You can consider working as a(n) 1.4 . It's a part-time job with flexible hours, and easy to do. You just have to scan items and handle payments.

vocabTable.example: Write suitable words to complete the conversation. Ben: I’m thinking about becoming a 13.1 . I love fixing cars and learning how they work. Lily: That sounds interesting! I’m more into creative jobs. I’m considering working in a 13.2 . Ben: It sounds fun! What would you do there? Lily: I would like to become a 13.3 . I enjoy styling hair and making people look good. Ben: That’s cool! Both careers are different, but both can be rewarding. Lily: Yes, they are! Have you ever thought about being a 13.4 ? It’s a good job for problem-solvers. Ben: I’ve thought about it, but I prefer working with my hands.
